place: Tamagotchi mascots at a fan festival

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Tamagotchi could die in your pocket, and kids still lined up to own one.

place: Bandai Namco's head office in Tokyo

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Bandai put it on sale in Japan in November 1996. In eight months, Japan bought about 10M of them.

place: three Tamagotchis in a fast run

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The trick was the pet inside. It got hungry, it got sick, and if you forgot it, it died.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Crazes like that fade fast. So why didn't this one?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Bandai kept bringing it back in new shapes, with colour screens and new pets to raise.

place: a map of the world from Japan

moments.what: Japan lights up with a pin

lines: Tamagotchi went on sale in Japan
and then in countries around the world.
More than half of all units shipped
layers.phrase: More than half of all units shipped

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: And it left Japan. By Bandai's count, 51% of all of them went to buyers outside the country.

place: the poster over a Tamagotchi shop in Tokyo

layers.title: Tamagotchi
layers.sub: shipped worldwide · since the first one

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: By July last year, Bandai had shipped 100M Tamagotchis. A pet that dies, and still sells.

place: a newer Tamagotchi in a hand
the Tamagotchi from the first frame

moments.what: back to the Tamagotchi from the first frame

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Fed it on time, or let it die: which kid were you? Either way, it was a Tamagotchi.
